title: olearia axillaris
intro: Olearia axillaris, commonly known as the Swamp Daisy or Prickly Olearia, is a flowering plant native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including skin issues and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Olearia axillaris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
